title: SIM Acquisition Corp. I 8-K Filing — 2026-04-28
summary: SIM Acquisition Corp. I, a Cayman Islands SPAC listed on Nasdaq (tickers: SIMAU, SIMA, SIMAW), entered into a non-binding Letter of Intent on April 26, 2026 to acquire 100% of American Industrial Technologies, Inc., a Nevada corporation and 33-year leader in telecommunications with manufacturing, logistics, distribution, and e-commerce operations. The acquisition is subject to negotiation of definitive documents within a 45-day exclusivity period.
